capabilities: Open and preview .html and .htm files in a pane
Edit selected elements through a properties panel for content, layout, typography and appearance
Edit table cells in a grid or paste tab-separated data
Edit chart titles, colors, legends and data via a grid or JSON
Save changes or keep an edited copy when the file changed on disk
disambiguation: Not a source-code editor; it edits HTML documents visually through a properties panel.
extras: Desktop only. HTML runs in an isolated canvas, so files should come from trusted sources; no telemetry or cloud service. Highcharts is not distributed, and remote scripts, network APIs, external iframes and PDF/PPTX export are outside the supported workflow. If another plugin owns the HTML extension, use Open in HTMLeditor+ from the file menu.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit HTML files in a vault, so HTML documents and their tables and charts stay outside the note workflow.

relations.evidence: Bundled offline runtimes cover ECharts, ECharts Wordcloud, Chart.js, D3, and Plotly.
Editing adapters cover supported ECharts and Chart.js instances

summary: Desktop-only plugin that opens, previews, and visually edits HTML files, tables, and charts stored in a vault.
